native_test_entries: test1: {'time': 2.2, 'state': {'sevseg1': 'off', 'sevseg2': '0'}, 'description': 'Initialization phase. After 1 real second, the timer should have incremented by 6 seconds. Since the timer value is 6, the display should show 06. However, according to the rule, if the first digit is 0, sevseg1 should be off. So sevseg1 is off and sevseg2 shows 6.'}

test2: {'time': 8.4, 'state': {'sevseg1': '1', 'sevseg2': '8'}, 'description': 'After 3 real seconds total, the timer should have incremented by 18 seconds (3 * 6). The timer value is 18, so the display should show 18. sevseg1 shows 1 and sevseg2 shows 8.'}

test3: {'time': 18.6, 'state': {'sevseg1': '5', 'sevseg2': '4'}, 'description': 'After 6 real seconds total, the timer should have incremented by 36 seconds (6 * 6). The timer value is 36, so the display should show 36. sevseg1 shows 3 and sevseg2 shows 6.'}
assumptions: Convert numeric test time to milliseconds; apply changed controls 400ms before observation unless explicit hold duration exists.
Normalized potentiometer positions0..1 map to ADC0..1023.
Every inferred button press is released after200ms unless an explicit hold duration is supplied.
